thread:
maria_g: Hey team — quick ask. Planning a model-sweep tomorrow (6am PT start window) that needs ~8x A100s for ~12h each. Do we have vendor capacity/quota to safely borrow that without impacting demos?
ashok: Quick status: region us-west2 has unallocated A100 slots but quota caps might block >4 per project. Can you confirm project id? Also consider splitting across two projects to hit quotas.
maria_g: project is redwood-sweeps-prod. Happy to split if that's the easiest.
ashok: OK. Two options: 1) request temporary quota bump (takes ~2–6h), or 2) split workload across redwood-sweeps-prod + redwood-experiments and use internal flow to aggregate results. For 2) add this env var and we can script fan-out:
```
export SWEEP_PROJECTS=(redwood-sweeps-prod redwood-experiments)
```
kevin_h: Also lowering per-instance batch_size from 32 -> 8 reduces tokens/sec and GPU hours a lot. If you can quantize to int8 that might cut GPU need by ~40%.
procurement-bot: Ticket created: PROC-8912 — "Temporary A100 quota bump / sweep reserve" assigned to @ashok. ETA for initial response: 1h.
vendor-liaison: Quick note from vendor: we can spare 6 A100s in us-west2 for a 24h window starting 2024-07-15 13:00 UTC. Next replenishment after that is 48h later. If you need full 8 concurrently we can shuffle from another pool but need confirmation by EOD.
maria_g: Thanks — 6 available helps. Can we schedule two waves (4 + 4) separated by 12h? That keeps each run within 12h and avoids quota bump.
ashok: Waves approach works but you'll need to patch the sweep controller to checkpoint between waves. Add flag `--checkpoint-after N` and we can resume.
maria_g: I can add `--checkpoint-after 6h` and orchestrate resume. Will open a short PR in the morning.
kevin_h: If you prefer single continuous run, I can quick-produce a config that uses dynamic batch packing to reduce needed GPUs to 5. Not guaranteed for all prompts though.
vendor-liaison: Note: if you go dynamic packing, we need to ensure memory profile per task stays <40GB. Send a sample payload and we can pre-validate.
maria_g: Sending small sample shortly. For now let's go waves (4+4) and I'll open PR + tag `sweep-ml-s1`.
deploy-bot: Reservation available via internal command:
```
./reserve-gpu --proj redwood-sweeps-prod --region us-west2 --type A100 --count 4 --start 2024-07-15T13:00Z --duration 12h --tag sweep-ml-s1
```
deploy-bot: Reservation created: RSV-7723 (use to cancel or modify)
maria_g: Perfect — thanks all :thumbsup: I'll follow up with PR link and payload sample.
ashok: Leaving a note to ramp down other noncritical demo jobs in that window to avoid eviction.
vendor-liaison: Confirmed RSV-7723 tied to vendor allocation. We'll hold 4 A100s as requested.
maria_g: Closing loop — thanks everyone. Will ping when PR + samples are up.
